_about: malecns corpus ledger: measured anchors for the two feathers + the aggregate readout table. The raw corpus does not enter the repository (.gitignore); this file is its in-repo stand-in.
_why_this_file_exists: the readout table must let someone without the corpus check consistency, but checking consistency is not verification — re-running the probes still needs a re-download.
_generated_by: fetch_corpus.py (rescans the corpus on disk and overwrites this file)

corpus_status._about: An honest record of the corpus state. The case's readout was measured in this state.
corpus_status.impact: when the corpus is missing, every corpus-derived readout (domain facts, three bands, three error modes) cannot be recomputed and only the readings anchor can be reconciled against; whichever feather is missing, that side's (annotation/transmitter) accounts fail as a whole
corpus_status.how: python fetch_corpus.py (GCS direct link, resumable; anchors in PINS)
